issues.on_page: Operating expenses (Salaries and Wages ... Wildlife), Depreciation
issues.issue: All airport operating spending and depreciation (about 5.55M) has function 'other' because no airport function exists. The fund type will be over 10% 'other'. Each line is marked review. The detail expenditure lines (detail[15..37]) use the same function.
Advertising/marketing is a defensible but loose fit; could be professional/contract services.
Air service development usually means airline incentive or subsidy payments, which could be grants/payments to other entities.

Capital grants (federal AIP, per the cash flow 'Cash Received from Federal Grants') are recorded as other financing, as the housing-authority capital contributions rule says, not as federal grants receipts. Defensible, but it is an assumption.

issues.issue: The PFC schedule is deliberately left out of detail (stated in notes) to avoid double counting with the budgetary schedule's Passenger Facility Charges 320,457. Defensible, but the schedule's own figures are not captured.
